description:
Responsabilități:

  • Administer and support Microsoft 365 suite configurations, policies and respond to user requests.
  • Implementation of new Microsoft 365 features and functionality (Microsoft Teams, Groups, Planner etc) and migrations to a M365 tenant.
  • Deploy and administer servers running Windows Server 2022, cloud(Azure) and on-prem.

Cerințe:

  • University Degree or equivalent expertise and relevant experience with Microsoft 365 and Windows Server
  • Good knowledge of Windows OS and administration tasks
  •  Experience working with Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Azure AD, Intune, Teams, Onedrive)
  •  Experience working with Windows Server (Hyper-V, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, File Server)
  •  Knowledge of Power Shell scripting
  •  Knowledge of SharePoint Online
  •  Knowledge of Microsoft Azure IaaS (Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Gateways, Backup
